title: AI vs ML vs Deep Learning vs GenAI
label: EP 1
banner: AI vs ML vs DL vs GenAI

yt.title: Four words, one family
notes: Think of an address: India → HITEC City

lines.text: AI. Machine learning. Deep learning. Generative AI. [1] Are they four different things? [2] Not really. Think of them like an address. [3] India, [4] Telangana, [5] Hyderabad, [6] and HITEC City.

bottom.headline: Machines doing tasks that need human intelligence

yt.title: The big idea (the country)
notes: Machines doing tasks that need human intelligence

lines.text: Let's start with the biggest one. [1] AI is any machine doing something that normally needs human intelligence. [2] Recognising a face. [3] Understanding speech. [4] Making a decision.

yt.title: Learning from examples (the state)
notes: Like learning ripe mangoes by seeing many
Spam filters learn from labelled emails

lines.text: Old software only follows rules a programmer writes by hand. [1] Machine learning is different. It learns from examples, [2] like how you learned to pick a ripe mango. Nobody gave you a rulebook. [3] You just saw hundreds of mangoes. [4] Show a machine thousands of emails marked spam or not spam, and it learns the pattern by itself. [5]

Deep learning is machine learning with a brain-like network. [1] Layers of tiny math units, connected together. [2] The first layers spot edges. [3] The next ones, shapes. [4] The last ones, a whole cat. More layers, more depth. That's why it's called deep learning.
Then came generative AI. It doesn't just recognise things, it creates brand new ones. [1] Text. [2] Images. [3] Music. [4] Code. ChatGPT and Gemini are generative AI.

So here's the whole address. [1] AI is the country. [2] Machine learning is a state inside it. [3] Deep learning is a city inside that. [4] And generative AI is the newest, busiest neighbourhood. [5] Every generative AI is AI, but not every AI is generative.

data.question: Your phone's face unlock. Which one is it?

lines.text: Quick test! Your phone's face unlock. Which one is it? [1] <pause 2> [2] Deep learning! It recognises your face. It doesn't create one, so it's not generative.
